description: A finished answer to a question, written with [n] citations to live web sources: one deep search reads the top pages and an LLM (gpt-oss-120b) writes the answer from them only, saying what is missing rather than guessing; when the pages lack the answer it searches again with new queries. Use it when you want the answer itself; for quotes only use contextfetch_answer, for raw sources contextfetch_search. ~2 s. Costs $0.001 ($1 per 1,000); depth standard (multi-search research first) $0.002, deep (deep research first) $0.003.

depth.description: fast: one deep search (default). standard or deep: research first, slower.

name: contextfetch_agent
title: ContextFetch written answer
